brief:
Switzerland has selected the documentary "Who Is Still Alive?" directed by Nicolas Wadimoff as its official entry for best international feature film at the 2027 Academy Awards, Shehab Wire reported. The submission advances the film to the international competition phase of the ceremony.

Wadimoff's documentary examines the human toll of the conflict in Gaza through intimate narratives. The film centers on the experiences and testimonies of nine individuals affected by the ongoing situation in the territory.
